analysis.mode: PSNR (noise_prior sigma 0.74-1.24 < 2) on 5 support pairs + verify_signals
analysis.support_validation: R1 fresh-draw reproduction of R0 control blur_motion:1 -> brightness_darken_shfit_RGB:3: pair0 47.61 dB CI 10/10; pair1 24.20 dB CI 10/10 (re-draw 43.11 dB CI 10/10); pair2 59.75 dB CI 10/10 (near pixel-exact, RMSE ~0.26 gray levels); pair3 32.91 dB CI 10/10; pair4 22.94 dB CI 10/10 (re-draw 24.04 dB CI 9/10; signal-mode MATCH 4/4: spectral_slope, wiener_kernel, mean_shift, variance_ratio). CI clipping (impulse_pct_zero) diff <= 0.06 pp, unique_G diff 0-2 values, hf_lf <= 1% on every pair. PSNR spread across draws/pairs (22.94-59.75) is fully explained by x_distortion blur_motion drawing np.random.uniform(-90,90) per call; content-independent signals stay matched at 10/10.
analysis.rationale: R0 pipeline confirmed, not changed. Pair2 near-exact reproduction (59.75 dB) plus pair0 47.61 dB are inconsistent with any additional or different step (noise sigma>=1, JPEG, saturation, contrast, quantization, gamma/HSV darkening, or a stronger/isotropic blur would all cap PSNR well below 40). Two alternatives tested on pair2 where the control was near-exact: order swap brightness_darken_shfit_RGB:3 -> blur_motion:1 gives 22.21 dB CI 9/10 with zero-clipping fraction off by 5.0 pp (17%), confirming blur-first order; isotropic blur_gaussian:1 -> brightness_darken_shfit_RGB:3 gives 26.14 dB CI 8/10 (hf_lf off 10%), confirming motion rather than gaussian/lens. Runner-ups are < 30 dB, so no alternatives retained.

signal_sources: spectral_slope_ratio 1.009-1.065 (< 1.08, all 5 pairs): mild blur; blur_motion:1 confirmed by near-exact pair2 reproduction (59.75 dB) rather than by slope alone (run_full_analysis returns BLUR_UNLIKELY early, so residual_anisotropy/PCA are never computed)
mean_shift -50.8 (pair0) / -42.7..-46.6 (pairs 1-4): matches brightness_darken_shfit_RGB sev3 c=0.2 (-51) after clipping truncation; verify_signals global:mean_shift MATCH (pair0 R0, pair4 R1)
clipped_fraction target 0.0605/0.2598/0.2924/0.3651/0.1459 reproduced by blur-first order within 0.06 pp on all 5 pairs; darken-first gives 5.0 pp / 17% deviation => order blur -> brightness
variance_ratio 0.709-0.837 across pairs explained by shift+clipping; verify_signals global:variance_ratio MATCH (pair4)

noise_prior sigma 0.74-1.24 (< 2) => NO_NOISE; pair2 59.75 dB (RMSE 0.26 gray levels) excludes any noise sigma >= 1; residual_intensity_corr 0.50-0.67 is a clipping artifact (dark clipped pixels have smaller |residual|), not gamma

block_boundary 0.9911-1.0047 (< 1.05; 0% FP threshold 1.1) => NO_COMPRESSION; unique_G 172 (pair0) / 203 (pairs 1-4) reproduced by the control simulation with diff 0-2 values => unique_G<200 boundary flag explained by darkening+clipping, not quantization

dct_zero_ratio 0.399-0.590 triggered MILD_COMPRESSION_POSSIBLE on pairs 3-4 but bb stayed ~1.00 and pair2 near-exact reproduction (59.75 dB) excludes any JPEG/quantization step; content-driven threshold artifact
pair4 SATURATION_weaken_sev4 flag (saturation_chroma_ratio 0.7356) is content-driven (shared pipeline: pair0/pair2 reproduced near-exactly without saturation); verify_signals full MATCH on pair4

blur_motion angle is random per call (np.random.uniform(-90,90)): same-pipeline re-draws move support PSNR by up to ~19 dB (pair1 24.20 vs 43.11), so PSNR spread across supports is expected and not a pipeline error
